items.text: The analysis shows that removing low-curvature components can reduce verbatim memorization by roughly **15%** on held-out probes while preserving downstream reasoning scores within **2%** of the unedited baseline.
Prior work on mechanistic unlearning often reports state-of-the-art perplexity on clean data; our editing rule **outperforms** a random-direction ablation on targeted memorization tasks.
